svg.text: Bloomberg annual estimates in US$bn | Jan - Oct 2026
August fiscal year-end | FY2026 has ended
Combined total | Samsung + SK Hynix + Micron + TSMC
Sum of reported fiscal-year estimates · US$bn
Source: Bloomberg Desktop API, BEST_CAPEX; fixed FY2026 / FY2027 / FY2028; USD override. Retrieved 29 Oct 2026.
Annual consolidated capex; Samsung includes non-memory businesses. USD history includes FX movements.
Total sums fiscal years: Micron ends in August; peers end in December. Micron FY2026 has ended. This is not a calendar-year total.
Total uses the latest available observation for each company; begins when all four have data. No backfilling before first coverage.
Lines connect available observations; dashed tails connect the last historical point to the current Bloomberg snapshot.
